machines.name: VESPER
machines.description: Short 32-cell signed excitation stencil, reversible read head, two damped resonant poles.
machines.limitation: The all-knobs-min and all-knobs-max corners can intentionally produce near-silence (e.g. no strike with a frozen memory); nominal patch is audible.

machines.name: MYCEL
machines.description: Four resonant nodes with six symmetric edges, bounded energy transfer and damping.
machines.limitation: Not a complete physical model; topology interpolation and coupling coefficients require target-CPU profiling.

machines.name: ORBITAL
machines.description: Path-dependent two-coordinate harmonic field with stored coordinates, hysteresis and bounded partial bank.
machines.limitation: The host path-dependence test passes; anti-aliasing and worst-case ColdFire cost are not yet established.

machines.name: LITHOS
machines.description: Six additive partials fed by smooth, granular and fractured energy reservoirs with bounded transfers.
machines.limitation: No FFT is used. Energy transfer is conservative up to integer rounding; excitation and damping are explicit.

machines.name: PHOTON
machines.description: Sparse periodic phase events excite a four-node reflection network; feedback is now an explicit bounded transfer.
machines.limitation: Event cadence is block/sample-rate state, not an arbitrary event queue. Phase discontinuity and aliasing need target validation.

machines.name: ANIMA
machines.description: Four autonomous virtual agents share slow activity and memory values inside one voice.
machines.limitation: This is only the safe voice-local fallback. No inter-voice shared bus or static global state is implemented.
